blueprint.title: English Paper — CSSE Style

sections.instructions: Read the story twice before you start. The second read is where the details land. Then answer in your own words, in sentences. Some questions ask for more than one thing — check how many before you move on. Spelling and punctuation count in your answers here.

Now the writing task. Plan for five minutes before you start writing. Read the task twice and check who you are writing as, and how it must begin. Write in full sentences and paragraphs. Better beats longer.
sections.perCyclePolicyNote: The writing allocation is a per-cycle policy of the exam setter, not a property of the format: one observed cycle in the corpus carried no writing task at all. Composition must be told whether this cycle includes it (SCP-E-7 reversed; §7 forbids hard-coding this).

blueprint.notes: Authored FROM corpus evidence (SCP-E-2/E-7-reversed/E-9/E-10/E-14). One deep comprehension cluster answered in writing, with embedded 1-mark SPaG riders reaching ~25% of comprehension credit, plus two contrasting writing tasks at ~25% of marks WHEN the cycle carries them. Open-response model throughout: no MC, no standalone SPaG (SCP-E-10). Timing is the analyst's reconstruction — one of the things the reviewer must verify. Types are forward refs to an English registry that does not exist yet.
